component.name: Zoominator
component.summary: Zoom and pan the whole scene to follow the mouse

description.p: Zoominator zooms and pans the entire scene to follow the mouse, on a hotkey or a mouse button, so the focus stays where the action is. It works at scene level: no per-source setup and no dock.
Global input and cursor tracking use XInput2, so the plugin needs OBS Studio running in an X11 session. In a native Wayland session its triggers and mouse tracking are unavailable.
